prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 版本更新日志（中英混排） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "版本" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 43px
  col 2: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "变更内容" · longest unbreakable word 90px · one-line width 646px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 472px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 471px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，方便读者追踪产品演进。","reading":"读者先按版本或日期定位一行，再通过类型判断更新性质，最后阅读变更内容；同一行的信息应保持容易关联。","groups":["版本与日期共同标识一次发布，适合紧邻扫描。","类型与变更内容共同说明更新的性质和细节。"],"keep_intact":["版本号和日期应尽可能完整显示，便于快速定位和比较。","WebSocket、OAuth 2.0、OpenSSL 等技术名称及版本号应尽可能保持完整。","类型标签较短，完整显示有利于纵向扫描。"],"may_wrap":["变更内容是句子，可在自然词语边界换行；其较长文本通常决定行高，其他单元格的换行可利用这部分高度。","空间紧张时，日期可在连字符处换行，类型标签也可换行，但都会降低扫描速度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [64, 108, 67, 232] · table 472×368px · row heights [36, 83, 106, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [64, 72, 61, 274] · table 472×299px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"版本号、日期和类型均完整显示，左侧三列便于纵向定位；技术名称没有被拆开，各行信息关联清楚。","problems":"变更内容列偏窄，第二条更新占四行，其他较长条目也频繁换行；左侧单行单元格随之留下较多空白，整表显得纵向松散。","cause":"日期列为108px，足以完整容纳日期，但与67px的类型列一起占去较多宽度，使变更内容只剩232px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"变更内容列更宽，长句的阅读节奏更流畅，表格高度明显降低；版本号完整，技术名称未出现词中拆分。","problems":"日期在连字符处断成两行，影响按日期纵向比较；“新功能”也断成两行，削弱类型列的扫描一致性。末行的CVE编号分跨两行，降低了标识符的易读性。","cause":"72px的日期列无法容纳完整日期，61px的类型列不足以容纳三个汉字；274px的变更内容列虽改善正文换行，但不能保证所有编号都落在同一行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[64,72,67,268],"change":"保留r2B较宽的变更内容列，将类型列加宽至67px以完整显示“新功能”；日期仍在连字符处换行，换取类型列的纵向一致性。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[64,64,67,276],"change":"将日期列收至能容纳最长日期片段的宽度，同时保持类型完整，把更多空间留给变更内容；检验日期换行和正文节奏之间的折中。"},{"name":"r3C","widths":[64,80,67,260],"change":"给日期列比r3A更多空间，同时完整保留类型标签；检验较宽的日期列能否改善断行位置，并观察正文增加的换行是否可接受。"}]}
